 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Dilip Kumar Roy  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Zainul Abedin  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 2 14-03-2024 Heard the parties.
2. The petitioners apprehend their arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 341, 323, 504, 506 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. As per the FIR, the son of the petitioners established physical relation with the informant on the pretext of marriage but when the mother of the informant went to the house of the petitioners, the petitioners abused and demanded dowry from her.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners that petitioners are quite innocent and have committed no Patna High Court CR.
They have been falsely implicated in this case.
No such occurrence, in the manner as alleged, has ever taken place.
The allegation levelled against the petitioners is not specific rather general and omnibus in nature.
The specific allegation is against the co-accused Raju Kumar and there is no specific overt act against the petitioners.

6. Case No.28 of 2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
